content:
mina_support: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting usage analytics delayed ~5-7h in Console. Seeing gaps in hourly charts and \"last updated\" timestamps behind. Example report from acct RED-482:

mina_support: Screenshot: https://files.redwood/reports/RED-482-usage-gap.png (chart shows empty window 02:00–07:00 UTC)

ingest-bot: ALERT: pipeline 'usage-ingest-main' failed 2026-03-14T03:14:21Z. reason=SchemaMismatchError, failing_topic=usage.events.v2, consecutive_failures=3

mina_support: Customers saying billing shows lower usage for that window. Raised a Priority-2 support case. Need ETA & repro steps for customers.

jordan_eng: Looking. Can you paste the exact event id / sample payload that's failing?

mina_support: From support case RED-482: sample_event_id=evt_20260314_9fa; payload excerpt: `{\"user_id\":\"u_123\",\"tokens\":45,\"env\":\"prod:eu-west\"}` — ingest logs show error: `unexpected field 'env'`

alex_data: That payload suggests schema drift — we recently added strict validation for usage.events.v2 to reject unknown fields. The 'env' tag was introduced by a new SDK release last night. Kafka consumer started rejecting the batch.

jordan_eng: Confirmed in logs: `BatchProcessor[partition=7, offset=34012] ERROR SchemaValidator - Unknown field \"env\"` then consumer paused. Connector retried and hit retry limit, triggering pipeline failure.

tim_ops: Also noticed higher disk IO on ingest cluster during that period, retries piled up. We had autoscaler scale down a node at 03:00 UTC (scale policy hit). Might have exacerbated backpressure.

alex_data: For immediate mitigation: 1) revert schema validation to allow unknown fields (fast) OR 2) run a backfill that filters out 'env' and reprocess. Revert is faster but risk letting bad payloads through.

jordan_eng: Safe short-term plan: patch validator to ignore unknown fields for the next 2h and restart worker pool. Then run targeted backfill for the 02:00–07:00 UTC window.

tim_ops: I can roll the validator patch to canary now. Command I used: `kubectl -n ingest rollout restart deploy/usage-validator --context=cluster/prod && watch kubectl -n ingest get pods -l app=usage-validator`

ingest-bot: NOTE: backfill job template `backfill-usage` exists. Default window limit=7 days. Docs: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/ingest-backfill

alex_data: Backfill plan: run `make backfill-run DATE_FROM=2026-03-14T02:00 DATE_TO=2026-03-14T07:00 JOB=usage-filtering` in staging first, then prod. Estimated runtime ~45m–90m.

mina_support: Please confirm once validator canary is up and ETA to customers. I've already told RED-482 we'll update within 30 minutes.

jordan_eng: Canary rolled, validators now accept unknown fields. Monitoring consumer lag. patch id=patch/allow-unknown-fields-20260314

tim_ops: Consumer lag climbing down. Starting prod backfill in 10m. I'll post job id and progress.

ingest-bot: JOB STARTED: backfill-usage-prod-20260314-01 (initiated by tim_ops). logs: https://logs.redwood/backfills/backfill-usage-prod-20260314-01

alex_data: Running sanity checks after backfill: compare aggregate hourly token counts against pre-failure baseline. Will post delta table when done.

mina_support: Thanks. I'll update RED-482: validators patched, backfill started, expected resolution within 2 hours.

jordan_eng: Postmortem action items (quick):
- add schema compatibility test in pre-release (prevent SDK introducing new fields without coordination)
- add alert on consumer retry spikes + autoscaler interference
- create a lightweight transform in the consumer to drop unknown fields instead of hard fail

tim_ops: Also scheduling a follow-up to adjust scale-down window for ingest cluster during nightly SDK deploys.

ingest-bot: JOB COMPLETE: backfill-usage-prod-20260314-01 status=SUCCESS duration=52m rows_processed=4,912,340

alex_data: Sanity checks: hourly aggregates for 02:00–07:00 now match expected baseline within 0.7%. Pushing metrics back to Console; dashboards should refresh in ~10m.

mina_support: Confirmed with customer RED-482 — metrics backfilled, charts repopulated, billing numbers corrected. Marking case as resolved, will ask customer to re-open if they see issues. :thumbsup:

jordan_eng: Thanks team. Will file a short postmortem and link runbook updates.
